newsitem.title: LATVIA: KRASTS REITERATES BALANCED BUDGET AIM-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: KRASTS REITERATES BALANCED BUDGET AIM-REPORT.

text.p: Prime Minister candidate Guntar Krasts wants a balanced budget this year and if this is not attained it will have to come next year, he said in an interview published in newspaper Diena on Tuesday.
"I discussed with all the parliament faction leaderships that we have to have a deficit-free budget this year," Krasts told the newspaper.
"Finance ministry figures show this may not be possible but in 1998 we are going for a deficit-free budget," he added.
Finance Minister Robert Zile has said that the budget deficit this year may be between 10 and 12 million lats and Krasts said he would aim to keep within this figure.
"This figure (12 million lats) should definitely not be exceeded. There will still be continued efforts that the budget deficit figure this year should if possible be lower," he added.
